title: Proxy vs scalar log-likelihood response in GP-BO posterior inference
setting: A deterministic damped-sinusoid simulator maps 2 or 3 parameters in [0,1]^d to a T-point time series; the observation is the true output plus Gaussian noise, and the exact posterior is computed on a dense grid. A sequential GP-based Bayesian optimization loop (8 random initial points, 36 simulator calls total, uncertainty-sampling acquisition on the implied posterior) builds a surrogate of the likelihood either from the scalar log-likelihood or from the full output vector (proxy), with the same kernel, lengthscale selection and acquisition. The metric is the total-variation distance between the surrogate posterior and the exact grid posterior after all simulator calls.

paper.title: Bayesian Inference of Expensive Simulators: Survey and Comparison of Design Choices
paper.claim: Modeling a proxy variable that retains the simulator output vector gives more simulation-efficient posterior inference than modeling the scalar log-likelihood.

metric.name: tv_final
metric.description: Total-variation distance (0 to 1) between the surrogate-based posterior and the exact grid reference posterior after 36 simulator calls. Diagnostics: tv_at_20 (TV after 20 calls), calls_to_thresh (calls until TV<0.25, capped at 36), mean_err (posterior-mean error in the unit cube).

factors.name: method
factors.description: loglik: GP on the scalar log-likelihood with uncertainty-sampling acquisition; proxy: shared-kernel GP on the standardized output vector, likelihood computed from the predicted output; random: random design with the scalar log-likelihood GP as a sanity floor.

factors.name: noise
factors.description: Observation noise standard deviation; lower noise makes the posterior sharper and the log-likelihood surface more extreme.

factors.name: T
factors.description: Number of observed time points (output dimension), i.e. how much information the scalar log-likelihood can discard.

factors.name: dim
factors.description: Number of simulator parameters (3 adds a phase parameter); the search space is harder with 3.
